# Termco support

- Ask installation and usage questions in [Q&A](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/discussions/categories/q-a).
- Share feature proposals in [Ideas](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/discussions/categories/ideas).
- Share plugin proposals in [Plugin ideas](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/discussions/categories/plugin-ideas).
- Report reproducible application and plugin defects with the [issue forms](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/issues/new/choose).
- Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/termco-ai/termco/security/advisories/new).

Before posting, remove API keys, tokens, private source code, server addresses, usernames, and other sensitive data from screenshots and logs.
